correctness.rationale: The characteristic cubic has three distinct real roots in (-1,0), (0,1), (1,∞) for all parameters; p(1+w)=w²-s² and Vieta exactly determine the modulus order, so the all-temperature switching threshold is proved. Explicit Perron vectors determine stationary weights, and nondegenerate quadratic root asymptotics prove the critical-window spectral and phase-weight limits. Rational polynomial identities and 57 finite parameter/limit checks in verify.py were replayed successfully; computations support but do not prove the universal result.

value.rationale: The exact sign change of the slowest nonstationary mode distinguishes positive and alternating spectral relaxation for all inverse temperatures in a natural finite-state Gibbs model with competing period-one/period-two ground components. It yields a factorized tie spectrum, temperature-independent sharp boundary and a piecewise critical spectral scaling coexisting with a smooth equilibrium-mixture crossover. This relaxation invariant is not fixed by the previously known equilibrium selection weights.
